dialogue.content: こんばんわ。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。時間になりましたが、始めさせてもらって大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm the counselor. It's time for our session. Is it alright if we begin now?

dialogue.content: こんばんは。すいません、時間を勘違いしてました。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm sorry, I mixed up the time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Is everything alright?

dialogue.content: 始めても・・
dialogue.English: Shall we begin...?

dialogue.content: すいません、お願いします
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, please go ahead.

dialogue.content: はい、では、
dialogue.English: Alright then,

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 学校のことです
dialogue.English: It's about school.

dialogue.content: 学校の事でお悩みなんですね・・どのような内容なのか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: You're worried about school, I see... Could you tell me more about what's troubling you?

dialogue.content: 意地悪な人がいて、学校行きたくないです
dialogue.English: There are mean people, and I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、それはとても困りますよね。学年を教えてもらっていいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult. May I ask what grade you're in?

dialogue.content: 4年生
dialogue.English: Fourth grade.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。小学四年生なんですね。意地悪な人はどんな事をしてきますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So you're in fourth grade in elementary school. What kinds of mean things do they do?

dialogue.content: 教科書かくしたり、上履き隠されたりする
dialogue.English: They hide my textbooks and my indoor shoes.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、、とても嫌ですね。そんなことされた時は、どうしてるのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. That's very upsetting. What do you do when that happens?

dialogue.content: とりあえず探す
dialogue.English: I just look for them.

dialogue.content: 一人で探すの？
dialogue.English: Do you look for them by yourself?

dialogue.content: みんなには言えないから一人で頑張って探してる
dialogue.English: I can't tell anyone, so I do my best to look for them alone.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。とても頑張ってるんだね。悲しくなるよね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're trying so hard. It must make you feel sad.

dialogue.content: そう。みんな意地悪…だから学校行きたくない
dialogue.English: Yes. Everyone is mean... That's why I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: みんな意地悪なんだね。誰か友達に相談も出来ずにいるのかな？
dialogue.English: So everyone is mean to you. Are you unable to talk to any of your friends about it?

dialogue.content: 友達いない…
dialogue.English: I don't have any friends...

dialogue.content: そっか、、一人だなっとか思って寂しい思いしてるんだね。友達欲しいよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. You must feel lonely, thinking you're all alone. You want friends, don't you?

dialogue.content: 優しいなら友達いたほうがいいけど、意地悪な人しか近くにいないんだ
dialogue.English: It would be nice to have friends if they were kind, but there are only mean people around me.

dialogue.content: そっか、近くの子は意地悪なんだ。それはほんとやるせないよね。
dialogue.English: I see—the kids around you are mean. That’s really disheartening.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 友達作るのも勇気いるよね。
dialogue.English: It takes courage to make friends, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 一緒にさがしてくれる友達いたら学校も行きたいっておもうよね。
dialogue.English: If you had a friend who would help you look for your things, you might feel like going to school, right?

dialogue.content: 意地悪されるから学校は行きたくない、友達いてもみんな嘘つくし裏切るからいらない
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school because I get bullied, and even if I had friends, they all lie and betray, so I don't need them.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか。嘘や裏切られた事もあるんだね。つらかったよね。ちなみにどんな嘘や裏切りがあったのかな？話してもらえるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been lied to and betrayed before. That must have been painful. By the way, what kind of lies and betrayals were there? Would you be willing to tell me?

dialogue.content: 隠されたものを探してるのを手伝ってくれたことあったけど、見つかったらゴミ箱にすてたり
dialogue.English: There was a time someone helped me look for the hidden things, but when we found them, they threw them in the trash.

dialogue.content: それは、ひどい！
dialogue.English: That's horrible!

dialogue.content: 意地悪するリーダーに自分の文句言ったり
dialogue.English: Or they'd complain about me to the leader of the bullies.

dialogue.content: チクったりってことかな・・
dialogue.English: So they tattled on you...?

dialogue.content: 遊ぶ約束してたら、実は意地悪するためだったり。
dialogue.English: They’d make plans to play, but it would turn out it was just to be mean to me.

dialogue.content: たくさんあるから、言い切れないけど、こんな感じ
dialogue.English: There are so many things, I can't list them all, but it's like that.

dialogue.content: 意地悪するために遊ぶ約束・・ひどいよね。許せないよね。
dialogue.English: Making plans to play just to be mean... that’s awful. It’s unforgivable.

dialogue.content: 沢山ありすぎるんだね・・
dialogue.English: There are too many to count...

dialogue.content: ほんっとよく頑張ってるよ！
dialogue.English: You really are doing your best!

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: みんな大っ嫌いって思うよね・・
dialogue.English: It’s natural to feel like you hate everyone...

dialogue.content: うん。嫌い、意地悪だから
dialogue.English: Yeah. I hate them because they're mean.

dialogue.content: 今はそんな中、しんどいのに、頑張ってるよ。偉いよね。誰よりも偉いと思ってる。そんな学校に良い事は一つでもある？
dialogue.English: Even in all of that, even though it’s so hard, you’re hanging in there. That’s admirable. I think you’re more admirable than anyone. Is there even one good thing about school?

dialogue.content: 給食がおいしいことくらい。
dialogue.English: About the only thing is that the school lunch is tasty.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ・・給食おいしいんだ・・
dialogue.English: I see... the school lunches are good...

dialogue.content: それくらいしか楽しみないから。
dialogue.English: That’s about the only thing I look forward to.

dialogue.content: 給食中は少しはホッとできてるんだね。
dialogue.English: So during lunch you can relax at least a little.

dialogue.content: 誰かと食べれてる？一人？
dialogue.English: Do you eat with someone? Or alone?

dialogue.content: 先生がいるときは、みんな意地悪しないんだよね。だから、その時間は安心
dialogue.English: When the teacher is around, nobody is mean. So I feel safe during that time.

dialogue.content: なるほどね、先生のまえは大丈夫なんだ。
dialogue.English: I see; it’s okay when the teacher is around.

dialogue.content: そう。みんなすごくいい子になる
dialogue.English: Right. Everyone becomes so well-behaved.

dialogue.content: ずるいよね。
dialogue.English: That's sneaky of them, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 意地悪すると怒られること知ってるからね。みんなわざとらしいよ。
dialogue.English: They know they’ll get in trouble if they’re mean. Everyone is so fake.

dialogue.content: きっとあなたは先生の前だからっていい子にはならずに、
dialogue.English: I'm sure you don't just act like a good kid because the teacher is around,

dialogue.content: 誰の前でも同じように接してるんだね、そう感じたよ。
dialogue.English: I get the feeling you treat everyone the same, no matter who is watching.

dialogue.content: 自分がいい子かはわからない。
dialogue.English: I don't know if I’m a good kid.

dialogue.content: きっと悪い事された子にも悪い子にも同じ態度なんじゃないかなと聞いていて思ったんだけど、どう思う？
dialogue.English: Listening to you, I got the sense you probably treat everyone the same—both kids who’ve been treated badly and those who act badly. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 意地悪な人には話しかけたりしないよ。余計にひどくなるから。あまり近づかないようにしてる
dialogue.English: I don’t talk to people who are mean. It just makes things worse. I try not to get too close to them.

dialogue.content: うんうん。意地悪されている子がいたらきっとほっとけないんじゃないかな。心が。
dialogue.English: Uh-huh. If you saw someone else being treated meanly, I bet you wouldn’t be able to ignore it. Your heart wouldn’t let you.

dialogue.content: そう感じたんだけど・・
dialogue.English: That’s the feeling I got...

dialogue.content: 僕以外には意地悪されてる人わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know of anyone else being treated meanly besides me.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。もし自分以外に意地悪されている子を見かけたら？
dialogue.English: Right. What if you saw another kid being treated meanly?

dialogue.content: そんな気になれないかな・・ごめんね。辛いのに、こんな事言って。でもすごく優しそうだと思ったので。
dialogue.English: You probably can't even think about that... I'm sorry. I shouldn't say things like this when you're going through so much. But I just thought you seem very kind.

dialogue.content: どうするかなぁ？わからない。
dialogue.English: What would I do? I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。。でも頑張って学校行って、給食が美味しいと思えてる事があってよかったと思ったよ。
dialogue.English: I understand. But I'm glad that you're trying your best to go to school and that you have the delicious school lunches to look forward to.

dialogue.content: うん。でも、もう行きたくない。また、明日いじめられるの嫌だから。
dialogue.English: Yeah. But I don’t want to go anymore. I don’t want to be bullied again tomorrow.

dialogue.content: そっか。とても頑張ってるから、もう心がしんどくなったんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. You’ve worked so hard that your heart is exhausted now.

dialogue.content: 誰かにそんな話したことはあるの？
dialogue.English: Have you ever talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.content: 明日から休んでもいいよね
dialogue.English: It’s okay if I stay home from school tomorrow, right?

dialogue.content: 前にお母さんに少し話した
dialogue.English: I talked to my mom about it a little before.

dialogue.content: 休みたくなるよね。あ母さんは何って言うかな・・
dialogue.English: It’s natural to want a break. What do you think your mom would say...?

dialogue.content: いじめられてるの知ってるから。
dialogue.English: She knows I’m being bullied.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ、、お母さん明日休みたいって言ったら何て言うかな・・
dialogue.English: I see... What do you think your mom would say if you told her you want to stay home tomorrow?

dialogue.content: びっくりするとは思う
dialogue.English: I think she’d be surprised.

dialogue.content: それはどうゆう気持ちなんだろう、、そんなにいじめられてるの？って感じかな？
dialogue.English: What kind of feeling would that be...? Like, 'Are you being bullied that badly?'

dialogue.content: お母さんに聞いてみないとわからない。
dialogue.English: I won’t know unless I ask my mom.

dialogue.content: お母さんに聞いてみようか、、
dialogue.English: Shall we try asking your mom...?

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: お母さんも私もあなたの味方になりたいよ。
dialogue.English: Your mom and I both want to be on your side.

dialogue.content: ありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 笑顔でいて欲しいから。
dialogue.English: Because we want to see you smile.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 今日は素直に吐き出してくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you for opening up honestly today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとう
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: また、辛い事あったら、いつでも来てね。味方だよ。
dialogue.English: If you're having a hard time again, please come back anytime. I'm on your side.

dialogue.content: 今日はこれで大丈夫かな？
dialogue.English: Shall we wrap up here for today?

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 終了させてもらっていいですか？
dialogue.English: May I end the session now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ではボタンを押させてもらいますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I’ll press the button to end it now. Thank you.

dialogue.content: (本日は遅くなってしまい、申し訳ありませんでした。ロールプレイありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (I’m sorry for being late today. Thank you for the role-play.)
